# YRB Nova

> YRB Nova is a UK website design studio building fast, custom, mobile-friendly websites for small businesses, tradespeople and startups. Sites are built from scratch (not templates), with fixed prices from £350 and launch in 2-5 days.

## Services and pricing

- [Services & pricing](https://yrbnova.com/services.html): Basic £350, Standard £600, Premium £800. All include mobile-friendly design, on-page SEO, contact forms and revisions until the client is happy.
- [Free website audit](https://yrbnova.com/free-website-audit.html): free review of an existing website with practical improvements.
- [Book a project](https://yrbnova.com/checkout.html): pay online and book a website project.
- [Web design in Leicester](https://yrbnova.com/web-design-leicester.html): Leicestershire-based studio serving local businesses.
- [Websites for electricians](https://yrbnova.com/websites-for-electricians.html)
